g.text: Live ACP integration — reusable module and first debug consumer
One local runtime per session; Docker replacement later
retain session identity and runtime mapping
ensure runtime; initialize or resume saved ACP session
validate/store images; persist message and turn once
dispatch one prompt for this session
scoped request; file bytes for publication
commit domain result and immutable asset
text chunks / tool call patches / native image generation
normalized activity with turn and generation
update stable records; append durable events
existing renderer registry mounts image / camera / tool views
Snapshot/event replay restores browser state; it does not create a new ACP session.
Agent JSON is typed command/result data, not authority to replace backend state.
Native image generation writes a local file; MCP publication makes it an app asset.
Separate private runtime state for every chat. No shared writable Codex home.
Permissions are answered explicitly; Stop cancels the turn and its pending requests.
Uncertain turns are interrupted, never blindly resent. Saved files/history survive.
Local process separation is not the final Docker security boundary.
M-ACP.md: module contract and integration gates. ACP-AGENT-STATE.md: state ownership.
Runtime orchestration, application auth, CAD delegation, and public deployment follow separately.
